title: PIM Employee Search by Name and Employment Status
businessObjective: Enable HR Manager to search and filter employees in the PIM module by their full name in order to I can quickly access individual profiles and verify contract types.
preconditions: Target application OrangeHRM is reachable in the test environment
User is in an authorized initial state on mobile

mainFlow.action: Navigate to OrangeHRM PIM Employee Search by Name and Employment Status interface on mobile
mainFlow.expected: PIM Employee Search by Name and Employment Status view is loaded and ready for interaction

mainFlow.action: Enter required input data according to standard positive criteria
mainFlow.expected: Inputs are populated and validated without errors

mainFlow.action: Submit or confirm the primary action
mainFlow.expected: Entering a partial or full name in the "Employee Name" autocomplete field suggests matching active records.

mainFlow.action: Verify acceptance condition: Selecting "Full-Time Contract" filter displays only employees currently engaged under full-time contracts.
mainFlow.expected: Selecting "Full-Time Contract" filter displays only employees currently engaged under full-time contracts.

mainFlow.action: Verify acceptance condition: Clicking "Search" populates the results data table with employee ID, first name, last name, and job title.
mainFlow.expected: Clicking "Search" populates the results data table with employee ID, first name, last name, and job title.

mainFlow.action: Verify acceptance condition: Clicking "Reset" clears all search parameters and reloads the default paginated employee list.
mainFlow.expected: Clicking "Reset" clears all search parameters and reloads the default paginated employee list.

alternateFlows.name: Alternate Flow: Secondary action pathway
steps: Verify alternative state matches expected behavior

exceptionFlows.name: Exception 1: Searching for a non-existent identifier
exceptionFlows.condition: Trigger condition related to: Searching for a non-existent identifier displays a "No Records Found" empty state indicator.
exceptionFlows.action: Display appropriate validation error or prevention mechanism (Searching for a non-existent identifier displays a "No Records Found" empty state indicator.)

acceptanceCriteria: Entering a partial or full name in the "Employee Name" autocomplete field suggests matching active records.
Selecting "Full-Time Contract" filter displays only employees currently engaged under full-time contracts.
Clicking "Search" populates the results data table with employee ID, first name, last name, and job title.
Clicking "Reset" clears all search parameters and reloads the default paginated employee list.
Searching for a non-existent identifier displays a "No Records Found" empty state indicator.
nonFunctionalRequirements: UI elements must have accessible and stable test selectors
